texts.value: Serine protease inhibitor. The major targets of this inhibitor are plasmin and trypsin, but it also inactivates matriptase-3/TMPRSS7 and chymotrypsin
Forms protease inhibiting heterodimer with TMPRSS7
Expressed by the liver and secreted in plasma
Proteolytically cleaved at Pro-39 by both the prolyl endopeptidase FAP form and antiplasmin-cleaving enzyme FAP soluble form to generate mature alpha-2-antiplasmin

disease.description: An autosomal recessive disorder resulting in severe hemorrhagic diathesis.
